about_the_game:
Demo Version Content Overview:

In this demo, you will experience the core gameplay of 《Claw & Load》. Begin as a rookie miner armed with basic mining tools, then evolve through digging, combat, and upgrades to wield advanced gear while commanding 5 meowling companions wielding unique weapons. Ultimately challenging the ultimate BOSS. The single game experience lasts about 40 minutes.

This demo includes:

• 1 fully playable level

• 5 difficulty levels

• 1 playable character with 2 class skills

• 14 player weapons / 18 meowling companions' weapons

• 50+ character traits

• 33 meta progression skills

• Single player mode only

⛏️Dual-Phase Survival: Dig or Die!

Time is your life—During Mining Phase, blast through blocks, harvest Crystals, and trigger explosive. When Combat Phase hits, relentless waves of ghouls, skeletons, and demons swarm in. Survive through tactical shooting, dodging, or letting your Mewlings’ chaos reign!

🐾 GUARDIAN MEWLINGS: Your best allies

These floating feline allies auto-attack enemies with randomly dropped weapons:Shotgun Mewlings shred at point-blank, Drone Mewlings rain explosives, and Aura Mewlings heal you! Upgrade their arms with Crystals and fuse with Relics to unlock ultimate skills: summon thunderstorms, toxic frog swarms, or screen-clearing fire tornadoe!

🌪️ ELEMENTAL CHAOS: Risk vs. Reward

Each run begins with a random Climate System (Fire/Ice/Electricity/Poison).Rapid mining boosts your score to unlock buffs like firerate upgrades or meteor showers—but slack off, and your advantages crumble. Will you push your luck or play it safe?

🔧 INFINITE BUILDS: GUNS, RELICS, & MADNESS

Upgrade Your Gun: Unlock split-shot bullets, piercing lasers, homing missiles—or transform into a walking turret!

Hunt Relics: Empower your Mewlings to shred bosses with hidden abilities!

Progression: Trade Mewshrooms for upgrades , unlock skills or borrow the Queen’s power mid run.

Procedural Hell: No two runs alike—randomized terrain, enemies, and loot keep you on edge!

📖 Lore

“Mortals! My ‘interest’ in Mewshrooms is… purely academic! DIG FASTER!”

The Eternal Night devours light but breeds magic-infused mushrooms. To earn the Queen’s “favors,” you delve into lethal mines, battling horrors and unearthing secrets. But beware—the deeper you go, the clearer her true agenda becomes…

😼 Ready to Serve?

Grab your gun, rally the Mewlings, and dig like your life depends on it—because it does!

“MY PATIENCE ENDS NOW! MEWSHROOMS. IMMEDIATELY!” — Demon Cat Queen

short_description: In the cursed Eternal Night Continent, ancient magic clashes with firearms as you battle for survival. Serve the Tsundere Demon Cat, fend off hordes of undead horrors, and command an army of Guardian Mewlings armed with bizarre weapons. Each run is a desperate loop of mining frenzy and combat chaos！
